name: Prime Boost
message: If you hold any of the numbers (2,3,5,7), move +1.

name: High Roller Step
message: If your highest card is 10 or above, move +1.

name: Scarlet Surge
message: If you have more red cards than black cards, move +2.

name: Low-End Lift
message: If your lowest card is 4 or less, move +1.

name: Color Pair Push
message: If you have at least two cards with the same color, move +1.

name: Nine or Queen Leap
message: If you have a number 9 or a Queen, move +2.

name: Unique Set Sprint
message: If all your cards are different numbers, move +2.

name: Twin Strike
message: If you have a pair (same number), move +3.

name: Perfect Sum Surge
message: If you have three cards that sum to exactly 15 or 21, move +3.

name: Step in Sequence
message: If you have consecutive numbers (e.g., 5-6 or 10-J), move +2.

name: Triple Run Ascension
message: If you have a perfect run of three (e.g., 7-8-9), move +5.

name: Wide Gap Dash
message: If your highest card minus your lowest is 8 or more, move +2.

name: Odd Pair Sprint
message: If you hold exactly two (2's) cards, move +3.

name: Even Suit Boost
message: If you have two cards of the same suit and higher than 6, move +3.

name: Shadow Royal Charge
message: If you have a black Jack or black Ace, move +3.

name: Heartbound Surge
message: If Hearts♥ is your dominant suit, move +2.

name: Fourfold Harmony
message: If you have at least one card in every suit, move +3.

name: Crimson Purity
message: If you have only red cards (Hearts♥ and Diamonds♦), move +5.

name: Club Curse
message: If you have 3+ Clubs♣, your opponent moves -2.

name: Spade Sprint
message: If you have 2+ Spades♠, move +2.

name: Heart of Power
message: If you have the Ace of Hearts♥, move +3.

name: Diamond Peak
message: If your highest card is a Diamond♦, move +2.

name: Shadow Advantage
message: If you have more black cards than your opponent move +2.

name: Odd-Even Twist
message: If your total hand value is over 25, move +1. else, move -1.

name: Overflow Boost
message: If your hand total is above 35, move +3.

name: High Floor Penalty
message: If your smallest card is 7 or higher, move -1.

name: Odd Suit Steal
message: If you have two cards with the same suit and both are odd, steal +1 from your opponent.

name: Black Ace Ascension
message: If you have either Ace of Spades♠ or Ace of Clubs♣, move +5.

name: Face Count Shift
message: If you have only one face card (J,Q,K), move +2; if 2+ face cards, move -2.

name: Scarlet Solo Surge
message: If you have exactly one red card, move +3.

name: Dark steps
message: If you have exactly one black card, move -3.
